decisions: Release shape: analytics-only orx-analytics 0.4.3 on the pinned published ORX v0.4.0; ORX is not rebuilt from HEAD, not tagged, not re-released.

The driver extension is minimal and goal-scoped: --goal-id g012 (explicit; default g011 unchanged), per-goal work dir (dist/g012) and decision file (docs/diagnostics/g012/distribution.json), the ORX product-input pin with moved-tag refusal (orx-pin-moved), a G012-labeled candidate record, and the analytics generated-directory exemption; no other gate is touched.
The G011 evidence and user report protections carry over verbatim (see protected_report and g011_evidence_protection).

Analytics stays a read-only analysis layer: the controller-token attribution is a read-only query over zcode session data (~/.zcode/cli/db/db.sqlite) keyed by run session ownership; it never modifies ORX state and never grants scheduling/recovery/replay authority.
implementation_plan_pointer: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md carries the five G012 phases (goals, success criteria, tests, status) appended as the G012 section; all earlier Goal history in that file is unchanged.
